articles.title: Why ECB collateral eligibility could boost demand for tokenized bonds
articles.snippet: Past ECB decisions offer clues to the value of using bonds as collateral, while US derivatives exchanges face a different calculation over their Bitcoin holdings.

articles.title: FCC authorizes SpaceX to deploy 1M satellites for orbital AI data centers
articles.snippet: The planned Starmind constellation will process data in orbit for use on Earth, as demand for artificial intelligence computing power continues to grow.

articles.title: Utah moves to dismiss criminal charges against Kalshi after trading halt
articles.snippet: Utah’s attorney general warned that the criminal charges could be refiled if Kalshi resumes operations in the state, while separate civil litigation remains unresolved.

articles.title: What Is Artex? The AI Hacking Tool Linked to the US Spy Agency Breach
articles.snippet: Microsoft says state-backed hackers and cybercriminals are using Artex to automate attacks with AI agents, exploiting familiar security flaws at speeds that leave defenders little time to respond or recover.

articles.title: Ukraine Passes Law to Legalize and Tax Its Crypto Market From July 2027
articles.snippet: The law taxes crypto profits at 18% plus a 5% military levy, cuts the rate for older holdings and puts stablecoins under the central bank.
